name: neon-law-navigator
description: Find a public template for a Nevada LLC or business agreement. Open the matching intake on Neon Law’s website to sign in and begin. You can also open your existing Navigator Projects.

interface.longDescription: Find a public template for a Nevada LLC or business agreement. Open the matching intake on Neon Law’s website to sign in and begin. You can also open your existing Navigator Projects.
defaultPrompt: Help me form a Nevada LLC.
Find an operating agreement for my LLC.

positive.prompt: Help me form a Nevada LLC.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer Nevada LLC Formation and its signed-in intake link.

positive.prompt: My Nevada LLC is member-managed and I am its only member. I own it personally. Help me start an operating agreement.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Nevada single-member operating agreement in the public catalog and offer its signed-in intake link.

positive.prompt: Help two companies start a mutual NDA.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the mutual NDA and link to its intake.
Show the Advisor Agreement and link to its intake.

positive.prompt: Help me start a master services agreement.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the Master Services Agreement and link to its intake.

negative.description: Open the Projects sign-in page without reading a matter

negative.prompt: Email the signed agreement to my client.
Read the filings in my private matter.
